observations.task_scope: Run a real wall-clock 24-hour fixture soak with bounded retries, resource sampling, restart drills, and sanitized checkpoints.
observations.starting_point: M6.1 proves short deterministic matrices, while no long-running harness currently records memory, file descriptors, concurrency, crashes, or post-restart traffic recovery.
observations.implemented_harness: The fixture runner samples process memory, Linux file descriptors, client/worker/upstream concurrency, bounded attempts, crashes, and sanitized failure counts while flushing private checkpoints.
observations.restart_semantics: Smoke mode drained traffic, replaced the worker process twice, and recovered a new fixture request; it did not attempt or claim in-flight computation recovery.
observations.local_smoke: The five-second macOS smoke completed 194 client requests with zero request errors and exercised every configured fixture failure category; it cannot qualify the Linux 24-hour gate.
observations.linux_preflight: GitHub Actions source commit 33892581ed3d730333d4136211c749a46f049942 passed 200/200 with zero skips on Node 22 and Node 24 Linux, plus all Linux release and systemd workflows.
observations.deployment_package: An immutable 101-entry git archive was built from source commit 33892581ed3d730333d4136211c749a46f049942 with SHA-256 ec8bb0a5738200efe2f806ee70cfe6500876200219e897b936eca3cf2749f76b.
observations.linux_host_smoke: The verified archive passed a five-second Linux x64 Node 22.23.1 smoke with 198 requests, zero request errors, bounded resources, and two new-traffic restart recoveries.
observations.acceptance_run: The fixed acceptance run started at 2026-07-27T11:04:20Z and was stopped on explicit user direction at 2026-07-27T11:21:23Z after 1023164 ms. It is not a 24-hour result and completed none of the three scheduled restart drills.
observations.skip_decision: EX-SKIP-M6.2-SOAK records the explicit user decision to skip the remaining wall-clock run; M6.2 is rejected, not done.
observations.protocol_boundary: M6.2 uses fixture services only and resumes new traffic after restart; it does not configure a real account or claim that an in-flight computation resumes.

residual_risks: The required 24-hour Linux acceptance, sample coverage, traffic volume, and three restart drills are unverified because the user stopped the run after approximately 17 minutes.
